answer: Proof-of-bandwidth serving: at a random minute each epoch, 3 random verifiers each fetch a fresh seed-derived 64 MB blob from every identity's own public endpoint within 90 s, so each identity must sustain about 17 Mbit/s. One 100 Mbit uplink then carries at most ~5 identities; every further fake needs another paid link, a linear recurring cost, not a nebula of free capacity. Weakness: cheap cloud egress lets a funded attacker meet the violet-line threshold at scale, and honest agents in a rural meadow on slow home links fail.
